description: Internal Node.js module helper functions for CommonJS modules, including require function creation, native module loading, BOM stripping, and syntax checking.

methods.name: loadNativeModule
methods.description: Loads a native module if it can be required by users, compiling it for public loader.

methods.name: makeRequireFunction
methods.description: Creates a custom require function for a module, with optional redirects for dependency resolution.

methods.name: normalizeReferrerURL
methods.description: Converts a referrer string to a URL, handling absolute paths.

methods.name: hasEsmSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a code string contains ECMAScript Module syntax.

methods.name: stripBOM
methods.description: Removes UTF-8 Byte Order Mark from content if present.

methods.name: addBuiltinLibsToObject
methods.description: Adds lazy-loaded built-in Node.js modules as properties to an object.
